body:
Reference check against the Haas Mill Programming Workbook (the maker's training document; local copy, not attached).

- **G187 contouring accuracy** (Preparatory "G" Codes List, p. 17; Alphabetical Address Codes, p. 25): `G187` (Group 00, non-modal) sets high-speed corner accuracy with the `E` word (`0.0001` to `0.25`, paired with Setting 85). **matches** on `G187 E`: `smoothOn()` writes `G187` with `E`, and `smoothOff()` writes bare `G187`. Smoothness codes `P1`, `P2`, `P3`, and NGC `P11`–`P20`: **not covered by the workbook**.
- **G83 and G73 decreasing peck (`I`, `J`, `K`)** (Deep Hole Peck Drill, pp. 77–79; High Speed Peck Drill, pp. 92–95): both `G83` and `G73` accept `I` (first peck), `J` (reduction per pass), and `K` (minimum peck) instead of `Q`. `G73` also supports `K` with `Q` to return to `R` after each depth `K` (p. 95). Setting 22 sets the chip-break retract in `G73` and the rapid clearance in `G83`. **differs**: `onCycle()` only writes `Q` on `G73` and `G83` and does not emit `I`, `J`, or `K`.
- **G73 and G83 dwell `P`** (Alphabetical Address Codes, p. 26; Dwell Command, p. 48; pp. 77, 92): both cycles accept `P` for bottom dwell. An integer `P` specifies milliseconds (`0.001` s), and a decimal `P` specifies seconds (`0.001` to `1000.0`). **differs**: `onCycle()` writes integer millisecond `P` on `G83`, but refuses any positive `P` dwell on `G73`.
- **G84 and G74 retract multiplier `J`** (Tapping Canned Cycle, p. 82; Reverse Tapping Canned Cycle, p. 83): both `G84` and `G74` accept optional `J` to set the retract speed multiplier. Without `J`, Setting 130 sets the multiplier (`1` to `9` times the tap-in speed). **differs**: `onCycle()` writes `G84` without `J` and does not emit `G74`.
- **M31 and M33 chip auger** (Miscellaneous "M" Codes List, p. 20; M Code Detailed Description, p. 120): `M31` runs the chip auger forward (using Settings 114 and 115, with door interlock). `M33` stops the chip auger. Each block allows only one M-code (p. 116). **differs**: `haas.cps` has no chip auger option and never writes `M31` or `M33`.
- **Next-tool pre-staging (`T<next>`)** (Alphabetical Address Codes, p. 27; M06 Tool Change, p. 119): `Tnn` selects the next tool without starting a tool change. The program can place `Tnn` on the `M06` block or on any earlier block. **differs**: `haas.cps` always puts `T<n>` and `M6` on the same block. Differences between side-mount and umbrella tool changers: **not covered by the workbook**.

Settled: `I`/`J`/`K` decreasing peck on `G73` and `G83`, integer-millisecond `P` dwell, `J1`–`J9` retract on `G84` and `G74`, `M31`/`M33` auger codes, and standalone `Tnn` syntax. Still open: `G187 P2` and `P11`–`P20` smoothness codes, and side-mount versus umbrella pre-staging rules, need verification from an NGC manual.
